reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: User-controlled param from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to response.sendRedirect(param) at line 21 without sanitization. Even though the redirect only executes when client IP starts with '10.', an internal network attacker can supply malicious URLs causing open redirect/phishing. Resolved sink value is param (user-controlled).

evidence.note: User input param flows to sendRedirect sink without validation
